gpSelfAdmin: Confirm my creator identity as admin
gpSelfConfirm: This device’s local record says you created this group. Confirm your locally authenticated signing identity as administrator? Encryption identity: {0}. Signing key: {1}. Other members must independently verify and confirm you.
gpAnchorConfirm: Confirm {0} ({1}) as this group’s administrator? Only this pinned signing key will be allowed to authorize reduced author protection.
gpDowngradeWarning: These members do not advertise signed-author support: {0}. Allowing them means any member with the shared group key can impersonate another author. Existing members will receive a persistent notice. Cancel keeps strict protection and does not admit this change.
gpUnanchored: No authenticated administrator. Strict protection cannot be reduced until you verify and confirm an admin contact.
gpDropped: ⚠ Author protection reduced by the pinned administrator. Legacy messages do not verify the individual author.
gpRestored: ✓ Signed-author protection restored. Unsigned messages are rejected.
gpChooseAdmin: Choose the verified administrator’s contact number:
gpVerifyFirst: Verify this contact’s safety number first, then confirm them as admin from this group.
gpFailed: Group security update failed. Unapproved changes remain blocked.
snLegacy: Legacy safety number · 96 bits. Compare only the same version; this display does not change verification.
snVersion: Different display versions. Both choose the legacy number and compare again. This is not evidence of a key change.
snMismatch: QR comparison did not match. Check the contact and both keys before verifying.
mrIntro: Messages from people outside your contacts stay here until you accept. Names and IDs are unverified; compare fingerprints before trusting someone.
mrPolicy: Stored on this device across reloads for up to 7 days: 20 senders, 20 envelopes each, 100 total, 2 MiB total (128 KiB per envelope). Excess messages and unsolicited calls are dropped. Nothing is decrypted or previewed before acceptance.
mrFull: Storage limit reached; newer messages dropped
mrFailed: Could not update message requests. Please retry.
daLinked: Previously unseen linked device (root signature verified)
daSession: Another installation used this identity (signature verified)
daPush: Another installation announced a push subscription (signature verified)
daRelayKeys: Relay reports different or missing account keys — unverified discrepancy
daUnavailable: Account activity checking is unavailable or incomplete. The relay may be withholding activity. This is not proof of a new device.
daLimit: Only signed, observed activity can be verified. The relay can withhold records. Session and push reports require upgraded, cooperating clients.
daRecovery: Unlinking revokes certified device keys on capable peers after the signed checkpoint arrives; legacy peers only stop fan-out. A copied identity or push subscription cannot be remotely revoked here: recover onto a fresh identity, notify contacts and stop using the compromised identity.
cvReverify: Compare safety numbers and verify again
cvCompare: Compare this number on both devices. It includes both encryption and signing keys:
cvMissingPin: A pinned signing key is required. Exchange an authenticated message first.
cvStrict: Block sending after a key change until re-verified
cvFailed: Verification failed or keys changed during comparison. Reopen and compare again.
cvBlocked: Sending blocked: a contact’s keys changed. Compare safety numbers and re-verify, or turn off strict mode in /verify.
vaultNew: New vault passphrase (at least 12 characters; not your /lock password)
vaultLegacy: Existing /keywrap passphrase, or leave blank if none
vaultScope: Protect keys, messages/files, contacts, drafts and private browser settings for all accounts? Save your recovery phrase and a vault file backup first. Theme, language and consent stay public. /vault lock locks every tab; /vault password changes the passphrase.
vaultDisable: Disable the vault for every account? Authentication is required. History, files, contacts, keys, drafts and private browser settings will return to vault-off storage.
vaultMismatch: The vault passphrases do not match.
vaultFailed: Vault operation failed. Check the passphrase and storage; no plaintext fallback is allowed.
vaultRecovery: This is not the /lock password. If forgotten, recover your identity using your recovery phrase on a fresh install. Existing vault sessions cannot be recovered without this passphrase.
vaultOldTabs: Close older Breeze tabs before changing the vault.
vaultBackupOnly: While the vault is enabled, exports contain only encrypted vault snapshots. Attachment downloads, cloud, automatic and recovery-kit exports are disabled.
opScope: Ipagpalit nang personal ang mga identity invite na ito sa DALAWANG direksyon. Mag-e-expire ang mga ito sa loob ng 30 minuto. Ikumpara ang fingerprint sa dalawang device at kumpirmahin lamang kung magkatugma ito. Panatilihing bukas ang app na ito hanggang matapos ang /rendezvous; kakanselahin ng pag-reload ang nakabinbing pagpapares. Walang alias lookup o relay verification.
opMatches: Inikumpara ko ang dalawang device: magkatugma ang fingerprint
opCompare: Ikumpara ang fingerprint na ito sa dalawang device. Pinag-uugnay nito ang dalawang encryption key, signing key at invite nonce.
opConfirmed: Na-verify na ang contact. Buksan ang chat nila at ipagpalit ang mga /rendezvous code. Ma-a-unlock ang pagmemensahe pagkatapos ng encrypted key confirmation.
opInvalid: Nabigo ang offline pairing: hindi wasto, expired, nagamit na o hindi magkatugmang code/key, o hindi sinusuportahang cryptography. Kanselahin ang nakabinbing pagpapares at magpalit ng mga bagong invite.
opPending: Tapusin ang offline pairing gamit ang /rendezvous bago magpadala. Gamitin ang /offlinepair cancel para kanselahin.
opCancelled: Nakansela ang nakabinbing offline pairing. Magpalit ng mga bagong invite sa dalawang device para subukang muli.
rvScope: Nangangailangan ng umiiral na encrypted session o nakumpirmang /offlinepair invitation. Ipagpalit nang pribado ang mga connection code sa pamamagitan ng QR o copy/paste; mag-e-expire ang mga ito sa loob ng 10 minuto.
rvQRTooLarge: Masyadong malaki ang code na ito para sa isang QR. Gamitin na lang ang copy/paste.
rvScanUnavailable: Hindi available ang pag-scan ng QR gamit ang camera sa browser na ito. Gamitin na lang ang copy/paste.
rvWorking: Kinukuha o bine-verify ang impormasyon ng koneksyon…
rvReady: Handa na / nailapat na ang code. Kopyahin ito papunta sa iyong peer, o i-paste ang sagot nila.
rvCopyFallback: Hindi available ang pagkopya. Piliin at kopyahin nang manwal ang code.
rvTrust: Kumonekta nang isang beses sa pamamagitan ng relay at i-verify ang contact na ito, o kumpletuhin muna ang /offlinepair. Kinakailangan ang naka-pin na signing key at isang session o nakumpirmang nakabinbing pagpapares.
rvInvalid: Hindi wastong connection code o maling hakbang sa pagpapalitan.
rvExpired: Nag-expire na ang connection code na ito. Gumawa ng bago.

rvTimeout: Nag-time out ang ICE gathering. Ulitin ang pagpapalitan.
rvCandidates: Walang magagamit na ICE candidate sa ilalim ng iyong mga setting sa privacy. Suriin ang iyong network / TURN settings at ulitin ang pagpapalitan.
rvRedo: Kailangan ng pagbawi ang manwal na koneksyon. Ulitin ang /rendezvous kasama ang iyong peer.

migrateGuideDesc: 1. On this device, keep a backup on your relay (automatic backup above, or Create Backup). 2. On the new device, choose a restore option on the first screen and enter your recovery phrase — or your account name and passphrase. 3. When your identity is back, a backup on your relay is found automatically and offered for restore. No cables or files are needed.

simpleDesc: Itatago ang iyong naka-encrypt na backup sa relay na pinapatakbo o kinontrata mo — hindi ito kailanman iniaalok sa default relay. Sa bagong device, ibabalik ng pangalan ng account mo + passphrase ang buong account, nang walang phrase na isusulat. Mas mahina ito kaysa sa recovery phrase: hawak ng nagpapatakbo ng relay na iyon ang ciphertext at makikita na may backup ang account na ito at kung kailan ito nagbabago, at ang nahulaang passphrase ay magbubukas nito. Hindi ito kailanman mababasa ng relay — ang passphrase lamang ang makakabasa. Pumili ng mahaba.
simpleNewDesc: Pumili ng pangalan ng recovery account — tulad ng email address, at dapat mong tandaan ito nang eksakto — at recovery passphrase na hindi bababa sa 8 character. Magkasama nilang kinukuha at binubuksan ang iyong backup sa bagong device. Wala sa mga ito ang ipinapadala sa relay; ang binubuksan lamang nila ang ipinapadala.
simpleSaved: Naitala ko na ang pangalan ng account at passphrase
simpleAccountMin: Dapat ay hindi bababa sa 3 character ang pangalan ng recovery account (mga titik, numero, _ o -).
simplePassMin: Dapat ay hindi bababa sa 8 character ang recovery passphrase.
simpleEnrolled: Naka-on ang simpleng recovery. Nakatago ang iyong naka-encrypt na backup sa iyong relay.
simpleEnrolledUntil: Naka-on ang simpleng recovery. Itatago ng relay ang backup hanggang {0} — i-update ito mula sa /backup bago iyon.
simpleNotFound: Walang backup na natagpuan para sa pangalan ng account at passphrase na iyon. Suriing eksakto ang dalawa at subukang muli.
simpleNotEnrolled: Hindi naka-set up ang simpleng recovery para sa identity na ito.
simpleRestoreDesc: Ilagay ang pangalan ng recovery account at passphrase na pinili mo. Kukunin ang backup mula sa relay na ito at bubuksan lamang sa device na ito.
simplePassChangeDesc: Pinapangalanan ng passphrase na ito ang ibang backup slot kaysa sa kinaroroonan ng iyong kasalukuyang backup. Mananatili ang lumang backup sa ilalim ng lumang passphrase hanggang mag-expire ito (90 araw); kakailanganin sa pag-restore ang BAGONG passphrase. Magpatuloy lamang kung sinadya ang pagbabagong ito.
toastRetentionOff: Patakaran sa retention: hindi pinagana (itago magpakailanman)
toastRetentionSet: Retention: ang mga mensaheng mas matanda sa {0} araw ay awtomatikong buburahin
toastRetentionInvalid: Hindi wasto: gumamit ng 1-3650 araw o "off"
toastExportedMessages: Na-export ang {0} mensahe mula sa {1} chat
toastGroupOnly: Gumagana lamang ang command na ito sa mga group chat
secAtRestWrapOn: At-rest key encryption: ✓ ON (PBKDF2-wrapped identity keys)
secAtRestWrapOff: At-rest key encryption: ✗ OFF (identity keys bilang plaintext JWK — paganahin sa pamamagitan ng /keywrap)
keywrapSuggestion: Naka-save ang iyong ID sa device na ito nang walang password. Magtakda ng passphrase para ikaw lang ang makakabukas nito.
secGroupFSOn: Group forward secrecy: ✓ ON (hash ratchet + epoch revocation)
secGroupFSOff: Group forward secrecy: ✗ OFF (static sender key; pinapanatili ng 1:1 chat ang buong FS)
secCallSignalOn: Call signaling E2E: ✓ ON (naka-encrypt na offer/answer/ICE)
secCallSignalOff: Call signaling E2E: ✗ OFF (SDP na nire-relay bilang plaintext)
secRecoveryNone: WALA — hindi kailanman mare-recover ang identity na ito
secRecoveryLegacy: recovery kit (ginawa bago ang mga recovery phrase)
secRecoverySimple: simpleng recovery (account + passphrase, sarili mong relay)
secSkippedKeys: Mga Nilaktawang Key: ✓ Pagbawi ng out-of-order na mensahe (max 100 key/session)
secDiagMsgStore: Mga pagkabigo sa message-store key / plaintext save / open failure
secDiagLifecycle: Mga outage sa data-lifecycle (retention / remote wipe / nilaktawang cleanup)
secDiagSealed: Mga race sa sealed-queue write na inayos ng relay (walang nawala)
secIceCandFilter: ICE Candidate Filter: ✓ (inalis ang mga host IP address)
secRelayPinMismatch: NAGBAGO ANG KEY — naka-pause ang mga tawag sa relay
secRelayEnabled: (nakatago ang IP mula sa mga peer sa pamamagitan ng TURN)
secRelayDisabled: ✗ Off (direktang P2P, nakikita ng mga peer ang IP)
secLblConnRoutes: Mga ruta ng koneksyon (device na ito)
secLanDirectNote: Walang awtomatikong LAN discovery sa web; para sa garantisadong direktang LAN connection, gumamit ng manwal na pagpapalitan (/rendezvous).
secTurnCustom: sariling TURN ng operator ng relay
secTurnUsage: Bahagi ng TURN sa trapiko ng tawag ngayong buwan
toastTurnQuota: Naubos na ang buwanang TURN budget ng relay na ito — sinusubukan lamang ng mga tawag ang mga direktang koneksyon sa ngayon. Magdagdag ng sarili mong TURN sa Settings para maibalik ang mga relayed call.
secBruteForce: Brute force: Exponential backoff pagkatapos ng 5 pagtatangka
secMemoryZero: Memory zeroing: ✓ Best-effort TypedArray.fill(0) pagkatapos ng crypto ops
secPledgeTitle: Ang hindi kailanman ginagawa ng Breeze
secPledgeNoAds: Mga Ad: wala. Tracking: wala. Analytics: wala.
secPledgeE2ee: Nilalaman ng mensahe: end-to-end encrypted — ang relay ay nagtatago lamang ng mga sealed envelope na hindi nito mabasa
secSealedSenderNote: Sealed sender: hindi nakikita ng relay kung sino ang nagpadala ng mensahe — ngunit hindi iyon unlinkability. Maaari pa ring iugnay ng timing at network metadata ang aktibidad.
secPledgeRetention: Pansamantala ang relay storage: hindi naihatid na envelope ≤ 7 araw, alias ≤ 90 araw, lahat ay awtomatikong nag-e-expire. Relay backup storage: OFF maliban kung paganahin ito ng operator nito
toastLockFirst: Magtakda muna ng lock password gamit ang /lock
toastAnnounceOnlySend: Announce-only ang grupong ito. Ang mga admin lamang ang maaaring magpadala.
toastScheduleMax: Limitasyon: 20 naka-iskedyul na mensahe bawat account
crashBody: Nagkaroon ng error ang Breeze. Ligtas ang iyong mga mensahe sa local storage.
uiNoReactions: Wala pang reaksyon sa chat na ito.

migrateHtml:
Lumipat mula sa LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Hakbang 1: Mag-imbita ng mga contact (1-on-1)
I-type ang /invite para kopyahin ang invite message → i-paste sa LINE/WhatsApp
I-type ang /qr para ipakita ang QR code → hayaan silang i-scan ito
Hakbang 1b: Ilipat ang buong grupo
I-type ang /newgroup Your Group Name → gumagawa ng invite link
→ I-paste ang link sa iyong LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Binubuksan lang ng mga miyembro ang link para awtomatikong sumali
Hakbang 2: Mag-import ng chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → i-save ang .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
I-type ang /import at piliin ang file, o i-drag-drop papunta sa chat area
Hakbang 3: I-set up ang mga notification
Pahintulutan ang browser notifications para makakuha ng mga alerto para sa mga bagong mensahe
Idagdag sa Home Screen para sa karanasang parang app
uiGroupRenamed: Napalitan ang pangalan ng grupo sa {0}
uiAnnounceOn: ON (ang mga admin lamang ang maaaring magpadala)
uiUnknownAdmin: Hindi kilalang admin command. I-type ang /admin help
cmdAdminAnnounce: /admin announce on|off — I-toggle ang announce-only mode
cmdAdminRename: /admin rename New Name — Palitan ang pangalan ng grupo
cmdAdminHelpLine: /admin help — Ipakita ang tulong na ito
cmdCryptoFwdSec: ✓ Bawat mensahe ay gumagamit ng natatanging key
cmdCryptoCompression: ✗ off ayon sa disenyo (iniiwasan ang CRIME/BREACH)
backupNudgeBody: Ang backup ang tanging paraan pabalik sa account na ito kung mawala mo ang device na ito. Sandali lang ito.
nicknameLocalNote: Nicknames are stored only on this device. They are never sent to the contact or the relay.
showPeerNameLabel: Also show the name each contact set for themselves
helpSetSaveDisplayName: Saves the display name in the field and shares your updated profile with contacts whose app supports profiles. The name helps people recognize you; it is not a unique identifier.
helpSetKtBlock: Blocks a new encrypted session if the key-transparency history looks altered or its saved chain no longer matches. This is safer than only warning, but it can stop you from messaging until the key change is verified or the setting is turned off.
helpSetBackup: Creates an encrypted backup on your relay when backup storage is available. The relay stores only ciphertext, but forgetting the passphrase means the backup cannot be restored.
helpSetRestore: Finds this account's encrypted backup on your home relays and restores it after you enter the required passphrase. Restoring replaces data on this device, so use it carefully.
helpSetAutoBackup: Automatically saves an encrypted backup after your data changes. It only runs after you enter the backup passphrase on this device, and only if your relay offers backup storage.
helpSetAutobackupArm: Lets you enter the backup passphrase once so automatic backups can run during this session. The passphrase is kept only in memory, so you may need to enter it again after reloading the app.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Opens step-by-step guidance for moving this account to another device using your recovery phrase or recovery account and passphrase. Your identity is not copied until you complete the restore steps on the new device.
helpSetHideRr: Stops sending read receipts when you open a one-to-one chat. Senders will not see when you read their messages; the messages themselves still arrive normally.
helpSetHideTyping: Stops sending the typing indicator while you write. Your contacts will not see when you are composing a reply, but you can still see theirs if they share it.
helpSetRelayOnly: Routes peer-to-peer traffic through relay servers instead of direct connections, hiding your IP address from contacts. It can make calls and file transfers slower or fail when no usable relay is available, and the relay operator can still see connection metadata.
helpSetNotifSound: Plays a short sound when a message or call that is allowed to alert you arrives. Visual notifications are separate, and Focus mode or muted chats can still silence alerts.
helpSetSendSound: Plays a short sound when you send a message. It is only a local confirmation and does not mean the other person has received or read it.
helpSetTabVisCalls: Shows or hides the Calls tab in the bottom tab bar. Hiding it does not delete call history or disable calling.
helpSetTabVisContacts: Shows or hides the Contacts tab in the bottom tab bar. Hiding it does not delete your contacts or chats.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Shows or hides the Profile tab in the bottom tab bar. Your profile remains available, and this does not change whether it is shared.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Shows or hides the Settings tab in the bottom tab bar. If you hide it while using Settings, Breeze returns to Chats; Settings remains available from the settings button or commands.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Keeps a local list of outgoing, incoming, and missed calls on this device. Turn it off to stop new call records here; it does not delete history already saved.
helpSetAutoLock: If an app-lock password is set, locks Breeze when you switch away from its tab. You will need that password when you return; this does not replace locking the device itself.
helpSetNotifPerm: Asks the browser or operating system for permission to show notifications. Breeze cannot grant this itself; if permission was denied before, you may need to change it in browser or system settings.
helpSetShowPeerName: Shows the name a contact chose for themselves alongside the nickname you gave them. This only changes what you see locally; nothing extra is sent to the contact or relay.
helpSetAddRelay: Adds another home relay after showing its fingerprint for confirmation. Extra home relays can improve availability, but each one can see metadata such as when and how much encrypted traffic passes through it.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Removes one added home relay from this device's list. The relay keeps ciphertext it already received until normal expiry; removal only stops future copies from using that relay.
helpSetFanout: For contacts that use multiple home relays, sends each message copy to this many of those relays. More copies can improve delivery if one relay is down, but they use more network traffic and store ciphertext in more places.
helpSetPowerMode: Controls how much Breeze reduces background checking to save battery. Sending is not delayed, but Saver and Emergency can make incoming messages and presence updates arrive later; Auto follows your battery when the browser reports it.
helpSetRrDelay: Waits about two minutes, with a little random variation, before sending a read receipt. This makes your exact reading time less precise, but senders still eventually learn that the message was read.
helpSetFocus: Turns on Focus mode for one hour. Most message alerts are silenced while it is on; VIP contacts and mentions can still alert you unless strict mode is on.
helpSetFocusStrict: Removes the VIP and mention exceptions in Focus mode, so message alerts stay quiet for everyone. Incoming-call ring sounds are suppressed too, although your system may still show a visual notification.
helpSetRestoreFile: Restores an encrypted backup from a file you previously saved. You need the backup passphrase, and the restored data replaces what is on this device.
helpSetInviteFriend: Creates a link or message someone can use to add you on Breeze. Anyone who has the link may be able to use it, so share it only with the person you intend to invite.
helpSetMigrateApps: Opens a guide for moving contacts or groups from LINE, WhatsApp, or Telegram to Breeze, including optional chat-history import. Imported history contains only what the other app exported.
cfStatusSaved: Token saved on this device, but not verified yet.
cfStatusConnectedNoAccounts: Token verified. Token status: {0}; no accounts are visible to this token.
cfErrNoProxy: Cloudflare setup needs a configured Breeze relay for the API proxy. Add a home relay first, or self-host Breeze and run setup there.
cfErrTokenRequired: paste a Cloudflare API token first
cfSaved: Cloudflare token saved on this device.
cfDisconnected: Cloudflare connection removed from this device.
cfNote: The token is stored only on this device. Browser requests pass statelessly through this origin's /api/cf-proxy to Cloudflare's API without being logged or stored. Verified relays with a relay key are added to Home Relays automatically.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Stores the Cloudflare API token only in this device's IndexedDB settings store. It is sent only to Cloudflare's API as a Bearer token, never to Breeze relays. Server setup needs a token with account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit permissions.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Calls Cloudflare's token verification and account list APIs with the token saved on this device, then shows the real token status and account names or the actual error. The token is sent only to Cloudflare's API. Server setup needs account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit permissions.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Deletes the saved Cloudflare API token from this device's IndexedDB settings store and clears the shown connection state. It does not revoke the token, and it does not delete the Worker, KV namespace, or any other resource from your Cloudflare account.
cfSetupDone: Server ready and health-checked: {0}. Add it as a home relay from the Relays section.
cfSetupUnverified: Worker deployed at {0}, but the health check did not answer ({1}). Add it as a home relay only after checking it.
cfErrNoAccount: no Cloudflare account is visible to this token
cfErrNoSubdomain: Cloudflare did not return a workers.dev subdomain
cfErrWorkerSource: could not load the bundled worker source
cfErrHealth: the health check did not answer ok
helpSetCloudflareSetup: Creates or reuses the breeze-presence KV namespace, uploads the bundled Breeze Worker as the breeze script with the required KV binding, enables its workers.dev address, and checks /api/health. The token needs account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit. The server URL is stored on this device only; add it as a home relay from Relays if you want to use it. Setup does not configure optional secrets for push notifications, TURN, or the relay identity key, so those features stay off or in their default fallback until configured in the Cloudflare dashboard.
lnSimilar: “{0}” resembles existing contact “{1}” ({2}). Compare fingerprints before trusting this name.
lnUnsafe: “{0}” contains hidden/control characters or a risky mixture of scripts. Compare fingerprints before trusting this name.
cfSetupToggle: Set up your own Cloudflare server
cfGuideText: Create an API token with Account Settings: Read, Workers Scripts: Edit, and Workers KV Storage: Edit, then paste it below.
helpSetCloudflareQuick: Saves the pasted Cloudflare API token on this device, verifies the account, creates the KV namespace and workers.dev subdomain if needed, deploys the Breeze Worker, and checks /api/health in one step.

helpSetTabOrder: Changes the order of the bottom tabs. Drag a row, or use the arrow buttons; the tab bar updates immediately. Chats can be reordered but is always shown.
helpSetInstallApp: Opens one-click app installation when the browser offers it. If that prompt is unavailable, shows install instructions or the desktop download banner instead.
